producers.apiVersion: Local Windows CIM and Certificate provider
testedVersions: Synthetic Windows Server 2022 shapes; native Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell Core 7.6.10 Pester 5.7.1 with mocked providers, not live platform validation.
prerequisites: Execute locally on one domain-joined Windows Server 2019 or later with 64-bit Windows PowerShell 5.1, native CimCmdlets, matching primary DNS suffix and domain. Use existing authorized local identity; no remote host parameters.
limits: Windows local provider metadata only. Missing optional roles, providers and restricted sections are not inferred absent. Named resources may be recreated; no automatic matching by host name to AD or other environments.

permissions: Read local root/cimv2 computer system and operating system identity (required for every section).
sections.refreshStrategy: Verify local DNS identity, joined domain and Server SKU; observe this one server.
limits: No domain enumeration, desktops, workgroups, disjoint namespaces or implied AD object identity.

permissions: Read local root/MicrosoftDNS zone metadata on the named DNS server.
limits: No records, lookups, transfers, server lists or zone contents. Provider not installed or unreadable is unknown.

permissions: Read local Win32_Share metadata; effective visibility depends on the caller.
limits: No paths, file traversal, share contents, sessions or ACLs.

permissions: Read local print queues through root/cimv2 and the spooler.
endpoints: Get-CimInstance Win32_Printer: Name; Local = TRUE AND Network = FALSE
limits: No network printer discovery, ports, drivers, jobs or documents.

permissions: Read Win32_Service name and state through local root/cimv2.
sections.refreshStrategy: Observe service name and reported state.
limits: Does not request executable paths, command lines, service identities, process lists or configurations.

permissions: List public certificate metadata in the local machine Personal store. Private-key access is not required.
sections.refreshStrategy: List only the immediate machine Personal store.
limits: No private key access, certificate export, raw bytes, subjects, chains or binding guesses.

sections.refreshStrategy: Record the directed provider association and its numeric dependency type.
limits: No effective application topology, load-order group expansion or credential access; missing service objects remain unresolved.

permissions: IIS Management Scripts and Tools WMI provider; read pool names in local root/WebAdministration.
sections.refreshStrategy: Read existing pool identities separately from application configuration.
limits: No application pool identity, process model, passwords, worker processes or recycling actions.

permissions: IIS Management Scripts and Tools WMI provider; read local Application identity and assigned pool.
sections.refreshStrategy: Record IIS site/virtual-path identity and only the explicitly reported, case-sensitive pool reference.
limits: No physical paths, files, connection strings, application settings, traffic analysis or inferred dependencies. Unobserved pools remain typed references.
